title: 3dLocalPV
description: Computes the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of the time series from a neighborhood of each voxel in a 3D+time dataset, which serves as a smoothing method for the dataset.

automask.description: Create a mask from the time series dataset
automask.title: Automask flag

prefix.description: Save SVD vector result into this new dataset [default = 'LocalPV']
prefix.title: Prefix for SVD result

prefix2.description: Save second principal vector into this new dataset [default = don't save it]
prefix2.title: Prefix for second principal vector

evprefix.description: Save singular value at each voxel into this dataset [default = don't save]
evprefix.title: Prefix for singular value

despike.description: Remove time series spikes from input dataset
despike.title: Despike flag

vproj.description: Project central data time series onto local SVD vector; if followed by '2', then the central data time series will be projected on the 2-dimensional subspace spanned by the first 2 principal SVD vectors. [default: just output principal singular vector]
vproj.title: Vproj
